headline: BBC slashes 100 jobs, closes two channels
standfirst: The BBC announced more than 100 job cuts and the closure of two channels Tuesday as the cash-strapped UK broadcaster aims to save £500 million ($668m) over the next two years.
body_markdown:
The BBC announced more than 100 job cuts and the closure of two channels Tuesday as the cash-strapped UK broadcaster aims to save £500 million ($668m) over the next two years. BBC News announced the “net closure of just over 100 roles” according to an internal note by director Rachel Jupp, part of some 2,000 job cuts the broader organisation is eyeing to achieve its planned savings. The job cuts represent £5.5m in savings, Jupp said in the note sent to AFP. (Dawn)

**South China Morning Post** adds: The BBC announced more than 100 job cuts and the closure of two channels Tuesday as the cash-strapped UK broadcaster aims to save £500 million (US$668 million) over the next two years.
